description: Email an invoice to the customer and mark it sent: pass invoice_id, and optionally to (an email address; the customer's own is used otherwise). This sends a real email and answers 404 once the invoice is already sent, so check it with get_invoice first. Needs a claimed Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

invoice_id.description: The invoice: its id, as list_invoices shows it.

to.description: The address to send it to. Defaults to the customer's own.

name: send_invoice
